configuration.licenceBasis: Existing approved Overture ODbL branch (docs/research/overture-source.md), USGS public-domain and OSM ODbL; explicit /properties/height lineage required. Unknown lineage excluded.
configuration.floorHeightSource: Existing heights.json#floors.perFloor; no fitting to this evaluation. Roof height is required separately.
configuration.overhangDefinition: Vendor vegetation classes 3-5 within footprint: >=20 returns and >=5% of surface returns. Proxy only; these labels are not used to clean DSM predictions, so Denver class-1 input uses the same estimator.
configuration.methodNote: Predeclared general baseline: 1 m per-cell surface p95 minus inverse-distance class-2 ground; building p95 of differences. All surface classes 1,3,4,5,6 retained. No fitted offsets or threshold tuning. These experimental estimator parameters are not validated accuracy claims.

sampling.rule: SHA256 namespace worldengine-density-thinning-v1 + EPT node key seeds SplitMix64 on zero-based LAZ record index; retain high-53-bit uniform < fraction; identical thinning for all classes

overtureProvenance.sameSurveyIndependence: USGS Lidar lineage may reuse reference survey; acquisition identity unavailable; not independent validation

limitations: Reference heights are uncalibrated grade D, not ground truth.
DSM and reference share lidar acquisition; USGS Overture may also share it.
Tree-overhang stratum is classified vegetation overlapping footprint, not manual confirmation.
Each rung is evaluated independently on observed buildings; selection bias versus observed-null buildings remains.
No candidate selected or exported; canopy contamination must pass the acceptance gate before use.
Random thinning does not recreate Denver scan geometry, occlusion, leaf state or class-1 classification.
Overture and OSM are unchanged external inputs: their sparse-run metrics are controls, not evidence of sparse-lidar robustness.
No rung averaging or bias correction; full-density reference heights and overlap labels frozen.
